svg.text: FTIR evidence for removal of native OA
Compare native-OA and exchanged-film infrared spectra

g.text: Infrared acquisition; no experimental trace or image generated

svg.text: Ethylenediamine; Iodide surface ligand; Bromide surface ligand
Output state: Compare native-OA and exchanged-film infrared spectra
Source scope: Thermo Nicolet 6700 with Smart SAGA accessory. Figure 2a compares OA with seven
exchanged ligands. Absence of carboxylate and C=C features in 1500-1700 cm^-1 is interpreted as removal of
native OA; particle size is not assigned to these spectra.
Illustration scope: Conceptual acquisition diagram. Instrument internals, beam paths and specimen drawing
dimensions are not measured geometry; source results are shown separately.
Source: Main PDF p.3, Figure 2 and ligand-exchange discussion; Main PDF p.7, Materials and Equipment
